title: browser-use/browser-use: browser automation built for AI agents
friendlyTitle: browser-use helps AI agents work with websites
summary: browser-use is a Python framework that gives AI agents a structured way to navigate websites and complete browser tasks. The project is MIT-licensed, actively maintained and has more than 110,000 GitHub stars.
friendlySummary: This popular Python project gives AI agents tools for opening pages and completing browser tasks. It is open source and has more than 110,000 GitHub stars.
whyItMatters: Developers can use it to prototype web research, form-filling and repetitive browser workflows with an agent. Run it with test accounts, narrow permissions and human approval for purchases, messages or destructive actions.
friendlyWhyItMatters: You can use it to test browser automation. Start with safe test accounts and require approval before the agent buys, sends or deletes anything.
